title: Eukaryotic Transcriptional Regulation: Enhancers, Silencers and Transcription Factors
method: Actual saved HTML p.teaching-prose whitespace-delimited word count; excludes headings, diagrams, captions, tables, questions, answers, revision and references. Article count excludes SVG and zoom buttons. Worked examples explicitly marked in theory paragraphs.

comparator.comparison: Target emphasizes regulatory addresses, mechanism discrimination, combinatorial matrices, independent quantitative models, comparative cellular cases and evidence instead of re-teaching pre-initiation assembly.

scope_review: Official merged CSIR–UGC–DBT page 4, separate CSIR NET page 3 and archived MP SET page 3 visually inspected. All 3.D.07 roadmap items addressed; basal initiation, chromatin remodeling and post-transcriptional mechanisms reserved for their own chapters.

coverage.structure: section 4: DNA grooves, zinc fingers, homeodomain, bZIP, bHLH, receptors
coverage.mechanism: sections 5–8: targeting, communication, silencing, spatial contacts, combinations
coverage.chemical_physical: sections 4, 9–11: free energy, affinity, rates and state weights

scientific_review: Pass 1: official syllabus mapping, distinct promoter/enhancer functions, modular factors, Mediator, Gal4/Gal80/Gal3 and glucose qualifications, animal receptor partner exchange, HY5 and Aux/IAA, model boundaries; landmark paper records and accessible textbook/review material checked.

Pass 2: separate saved-source review of occupancy versus output, standard free-energy sign, allowed binding states, interaction contrasts, rate/flux dimensions, reporter controls, EMSA/ChIP inferential limits, cis/trans and dominant-negative assumptions. Corrected Gal3 ATP-binding wording, repression terminology and answer position pattern; added prerequisite links and marked examples.

arithmetic_checks.method: Independent JavaScript recomputation of all explicit quantitative model cases and numerical practice answers; rounding tolerance 0.006.

academic_self_review.method: Internal editorial rubric, not external review. Deductions: scientific source-access limits (1), historical raw-data access and experimental validation limits (1), question difficulty/distractor quality not externally calibrated (1), interactive device/browser and full accessibility testing not performed (2).

limitations: Internal review only, not external peer review.
Official State SET comparison uses archived MP SET 2024 copy; current primary MPPSC-hosted copy not independently verified.
Accessible textbook/review excerpts and primary bibliographic records checked, not all full primary papers.
Static HTML/SVG source audit only, not comprehensive device/browser or accessibility testing.
Immediate adjacent chapters were not published at reconciliation; reader resolves them dynamically once linked.
Deployment and live verification separate from commit.
